+import json
 from copy import deepcopy
 
+
+def _merge_layer(target, layer):
+    for key, value in layer.items():
+        if value is None:
+            target.pop(key, None)
+        elif isinstance(value, dict):
+            child = target.get(key)
+            if not isinstance(child, dict):
+                child = target[key] = {}
+            _merge_layer(child, value)
+        else:
+            target[key] = deepcopy(value)
+
+
+def _reject_non_json_constant(value):
+    raise ValueError(f"Invalid JSON constant: {value}")
+
+
 def resolve(defaults, layers, env):
     result = deepcopy(defaults)
     for layer in layers:
-        result.update(layer)
+        _merge_layer(result, layer)
+
+    prefix = "APP__"
+    for name in sorted(env):
+        if not name.startswith(prefix):
+            continue
+        path = name[len(prefix):].lower().split("__")
+        if not all(path):
+            continue
+
+        raw_value = env[name]
+        try:
+            value = json.loads(raw_value, parse_constant=_reject_non_json_constant)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            value = deepcopy(raw_value)
+
+        target = result
+        for key in path[:-1]:
+            child = target.get(key)
+            if not isinstance(child, dict):
+                child = target[key] = {}
+            target = child
+        target[path[-1]] = value
+
     return result
